proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: reduce by construction to open immersions and proper morphisms; for an open immersion j_! is a left adjoint to pullback hence commutes with direct sums by the adjointness lemma; in the proper case Rf_! = Rf_* and the result follows from the bounded below direct sum lemma and, for torsion coefficient rings, from the proper mod n direct sums lemma (source lines 3775-3788)
